La:Y ratio, H4/YH6 impurities and phase assignment need sample-level review.

observations.label: Tc by method
observations.scope: Table 1 second material column, visually checked
observations.value: McMillan 22 K; Allen–Dynes 23 K; Eliashberg 23 K

rows.summary: Table 1 binds MgH26 to 200 GPa, μ*=0.1 and distinct calculated Tc methods. Its 23 K is a model result; it is not the 164 K prediction for LaMg3H28.
unknowns: No experimental superconductivity is established by this source.
The 2×2×2 phonon sampling and molecular-H phase remain model limitations.

observations.scope: Composition-series evidence, not automatic exact-sample binding

observations.scope: Synthesis only; not superconducting measurement pressure

rows.summary: Zero resistance appears from x≥0.07. The text adjoining pages 7–8 links the maximum onset to x=0.07, while the abstract and later phase-diagram discussion use x=0.09. This is a source-internal composition issue.
unknowns: Resolve nominal versus analyzed x and the conflicting maximum-Tc assignments before updating the 23 K occurrence.
The 2 GPa synthesis pressure is not the measurement pressure.

observations.label: Measurement
observations.scope: 2–300 K measurement range, not Tc itself

rows.summary: The source assigns its 12 K optimum to nominal Ni x=0.05. Measurements concern sintered solid-state-reaction samples; nominal doping is not a verified local occupancy map.
unknowns: Refined Ni content and exact Tc criterion of the retained occurrence need review.
Measurement pressure is not supplied in the inspected window.

observations.label: Device transition
observations.scope: After current annealing, not pristine material

rows.summary: The approximately 9 K transition belongs to annealed/doped devices. The nominal parent formula must not imply pristine Re6Se8Cl2 is intrinsically superconducting.
unknowns: Post-anneal Cl stoichiometry and the exact retained device remain unresolved.
No single Tc criterion or universal transition is inferred across devices.

observations.label: Reported structure
observations.scope: Powder refinement; no coordinates validated by this batch

rows.summary: The 7 K source study combines transport, magnetization, heat capacity and μSR on a polycrystalline material. Several retained measurement records remain one paper, not independent replication.
unknowns: Exact criterion and occurrence-to-specimen correspondence remain pending.
The inferred coupling parameter is not an independent DFPT measurement.

observations.label: High-pressure transition
observations.scope: Author-reported pressure dependence, not ambient Tc

rows.summary: The selected paper concerns pressure-induced superconductivity after antiferromagnetic suppression. Ambient TN≈88.5 K and room-temperature XRD pressures are not superconducting Tc conditions.
unknowns: Associate each retained Tc and each linked paper with its own pressure and criterion.
This inspection does not certify ambient superconductivity or the highest-pressure phase purity.

observations.label: Reported phase
observations.scope: Dominant phase, not a pure-phase assertion

observations.label: Carbon-doped controls
observations.scope: Censored result for x=0.12/0.16; not a zero-temperature value
observations.value: No resistivity drop down to 1.8 K

rows.summary: The carbon-free source composition is the 7 K superconductor. Carbon-doped x=0.12 and 0.16 controls show no resistivity drop down to 1.8 K, which is a detection limit rather than Tc=0.
unknowns: Exact physical specimen and pressure association remain pending.
A nominal metal-deficient formula is not a validated occupancy model.

observations.label: Transport specimen
observations.value: Dense polycrystal pressed from crystals at 6 GPa

rows.summary: Nb2P5 is synthesized under pressure and quenched before characterization. Single-crystal diffraction and a pressed dense-polycrystal transport specimen must remain separate sample roles.
unknowns: The 3.5 GPa reaction and 6 GPa pressing pressures are not Tc measurement conditions.
Transport, diffraction and magnetic specimen correspondence needs review.

rows.summary: Table I's Be:Al 24:976 row is a virtual-crystal calculation. The bracketed 1.18 K refers to the doping metal, not an experimental confirmation of the exact alloy.
unknowns: No exact-alloy experimental confirmation is established here.
The virtual-crystal/Debye interpolation assumptions require model-scope retention.

No child-specific heat-capacity confirmation is inferred from the parent row.
